mutation: Replace only the repeated initial literal-event charge with a locally updated count cost at the actual decoded byte contexts. Preserve candidate enumeration, literal predictor, copy prices, 0.5-bit admission threshold, and decoder.

controls.K: Compute corrected prices but select using unchanged parent prices

tests: P/K archive and complete witness identity
Every arm independently decoded by the unmodified parent
Deterministic encode from reconstructed synthetic input
Observed/unobserved archive identity and encoder/decoder complete witnesses

Retain every synthetic archive size, including losses
stop_rule: Any inverse, repeat, P/K or shared-state mismatch blocks corpus integration. Synthetic sizes do not select a corpus configuration. A separately frozen and published corpus gate is required.
scope: Synthetic integration only; no HORIZON, MIDAS, corpus, decoder, predictor, or sealed source mutation.
